classes.name: Sass
classes.description: A controller class responsible for compiling SCSS files into CSS within the OpenCart catalog startup namespace.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Scans the 'view/stylesheet/' directory for SCSS files, compiles each file into CSS using the ScssPhp compiler if needed, and writes the output to the corresponding CSS files, considering the 'developer_sass' configuration setting.
